# Change Request (CR)

## Change Description
<!-- Describe the proposed change clearly and briefly. -->

## Requester
<!-- Identify who requested the change. -->

## Date Submitted
<!-- Record the date when the change request was submitted. -->

## Related Module / Workflow / FR / WBS
<!-- Identify the affected module, workflow, Functional Requirement, or WBS item if applicable. -->

## Current Baseline
<!-- Describe the currently agreed scope, requirement, deliverable, schedule, effort, or resource baseline affected by this request. -->

## Proposed Change
<!-- Describe what is proposed to be changed, added, or removed. -->

## Reason / Expected Benefit
<!-- Explain why this change is requested and its expected benefit. -->

## Impact Assessment

### Scope / Requirements Impact
<!-- Describe the impact on Product Scope, FR, NFR, workflow, or deliverables. -->

### Schedule / Milestone Impact
<!-- Describe the impact on schedule, dependencies, or milestones. -->

### Effort / Resource Impact
<!-- Estimate additional effort or resource requirements, if applicable. -->

### Quality / Risk Impact
<!-- Describe potential impact on quality, risks, testing, or project constraints. -->

## Team Recommendation
<!-- Record the team's recommendation: Accept, Reject, or Defer, with rationale. This is a recommendation, not approval. -->

## Approval / Decision
<!-- Record the approver, final decision, decision date, and rationale. Leave pending if no decision has been made. -->

## Implementation Status
<!-- Record the implementation status and verification evidence, if applicable. -->
